title: Get Out (Tuco)
blurb: GET OUT — Tuco Salamanca's unhinged scream from Breaking Bad, played by Raymond Cruz as a man whose mood flips from celebration to violence mid-sentence. TikTok extracted it and made it the definitive ejection notice. What sells it is the disproportion: this is a drug kingpin evicting someone from his home, now deployed against pineapple pizza, bad takes, and intrusive thoughts. There's no comeback to it — the conversation, the visit, and arguably the friendship are simply over. Currently one of the most-searched meme sounds anywhere, and a permanent fixture of the reaction canon.
origin: Tuco Salamanca's scream from Breaking Bad, viral on TikTok as the universal ejection sound.
